title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff and regional failover load-shedding
author: Ravi Patel
description: Motivation: During the Feb 14th incident we observed SLO enforcer thrashing when regional failover caused transient capacity imbalance. The enforcer aggressively tripped circuit-breakers and applied load-shedding and then immediately retried, causing cascade oscillation and longer tail latency. This hotfix introduces a conservative exponential backoff for SLO enforcer transitions, a short hysteresis window for regional failover decisions, improved metrics/alerts to detect oscillation, and a feature-flagged rollout. Changes include: 1) replace immediate re-evaluation of circuit-breaker state with an exponential backoff per-route with jitter (configurable, default max backoff 30s); 2) add a 10s hysteresis window before a regional failover decision can be reversed to avoid flip-flop on intermittent errors; 3) change load-shedding policy to prefer coordinated token-throttling over full-request-drop for high-importance routes; 4) surface two new metrics slo_enforcer.backoff_seconds and slo_enforcer.hysteresis_events and a debug log for decision reasons; 5) add integration tests that simulate regional latency spikes and assert no more than one failover reversal in a 60s window; 6) add feature flag sle/stability.hotfix. Rollout plan: merged to main behind feature-flag, staged to canary region for 30m, monitor slo_enforcer.backoff_seconds and regional-failover-rate, then enable globally. Rollback plan: disable feature flag or revert the single commit toggling the flag; configuration defaults are conservative to tilt towards safety. Related: ENG-2145 (incident postmortem), ENG-2160 (slo enforcer test harness). Checklist: unit tests added; integration tests added; updated runbooks and dashboards; documented flag in ops/feature-flags.md.

review_comments: Ava Martinez: Question: Is the default max backoff 30s safe for high-traffic low-latency routes? Suggest a per-route override and a lower default for 'critical' routes.
Ravi Patel: Reply: Agreed; added per-route override in pkg/config/defaults.yaml and set critical_route_default_max_backoff=5s. Kept global default 30s to protect against noisy multi-region failovers.
Diego Alvarez: Nit: add a small unit test to validate jitter boundaries so we don't end up with pathological values.
Ravi Patel: Addressed: added unit test in services/slo-enforcer/tests/backoff_unit.rs to assert jitter is bounded and deterministic under seeded RNG.
Samira Khan: Approve after CI; please ensure dashboards include the new metrics with sensible thresholds before full rollout.
Ravi Patel: Ack and added grafana dashboard edits to telemetry/metrics_registry.yaml; will enable on canary only initially.

release_notes: Hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer to prevent oscillation during regional failovers. Adds conservative exponential backoff and hysteresis, new metrics, and a feature flag for staged rollout.
notes_for_ops: Enable feature flag sle/stability.hotfix in canary region first. Monitor slo_enforcer.backoff_seconds, slo_enforcer.hysteresis_events, regional-failover-rate, and p50/p95 latency for critical routes. If oscillation persists, disable feature flag and run rollback script ops/scripts/disable_sle_stability.sh.
testing: Unit tests added for backoff and jitter; integration test simulates regional latency spike and asserts failover reversal <=1 in 60s; manual canary run executed for 30m with no oscillation observed; smoke tested on dedicated and hosted modes.
notes: This PR is intentionally conservative and feature-flagged. We may tune defaults after telemetry from canary. Key config knobs exposed: max_backoff_seconds, initial_backoff_seconds, backoff_jitter_fraction, hysteresis_seconds, critical_route_backoff_override.
